Interface RemoteController

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClientHandler
public interface RemoteController extends Remote
Remote interface for the controller, allowing remote method invocation (RMI). This interface defines methods that can be called by clients to interact with the game.
